scope: Canonical localized tool page primary H1 across Browser FAST

firstObserved.evidence: Browser FAST failed the same four tool H1 assertions on Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit

expected: The canonical page H1, breadcrumbs, workspace label, and SEO metadata must derive the reviewed tool name from one authoritative resolver.
actual: The canonical page rendered getToolUiTitle(), while getToolSeo() and the localization runtime contract used getAuthoritativeToolSeoName(). The split produced missing/wrong H1 assertions for exif-cleaner, image-cropper, image-ocr, and Arabic image-compressor.

changes: Render canonical visible tool labels from getAuthoritativeToolSeoName().
Remove the only runtime consumer of the parallel UI title resolver.
Delete the obsolete parallel UI title resolver to prevent a second title authority.

verificationRequired: Final certification on fresh exact SHA
